name: Intermediate 4-4: Cull Pattern and Dispatch â€” Boolean List Filtering
brief: Cull Pattern with boolean patterns (True/False) to filter lists. Also Dispatch for splitting into two outputs. Polygon and Circle at filtered points.
context: Demonstrates boolean-based list filtering operations. Cull Pattern: takes a List and a boolean Pattern (True/False values). True items are kept, False items are removed. Panel shows boolean data patterns being used. Dispatch: similar to Cull Pattern but splits into TWO output lists (List A = True items, List B = False items). Both filtered lists used to create geometry: Polygon component at True-filtered points. Circle component at other points (or vice versa). Shows how boolean patterns control which elements receive which geometry.
category: Intermediate - Surface Creation and List Operations
solution_principle: Cull Pattern removes items where the pattern is False â€” filters to ONE output. Dispatch splits items into TWO outputs based on the pattern â€” nothing is lost. Boolean patterns can be manually defined or generated by comparison components. This is the foundation for selective geometry creation â€” different geometry at different points.
